qualification.details: DIPLOMA MECHANICAL ENGINEER ON FTC: Full Time Diploma Engineers in Mechanical discipline passing out in 2025 & or 2026 with minimum 65% aggregate or equivalent without any active backlog from a reputed / government approved institute. Preferably not less than one year work experience in power plant. Freshers may also apply. GENERAL MANAGER (FINANCE): A Graduate with professional qualification - Chartered Accountant / CMA. Preferably 27 years of post-qualification hand on experience. ADDITIONAL GENERAL MANAGER (FINANCE): A Graduate with professional qualification - Chartered Accountant / CMA. Preferably 24 years of post-qualification hand on experience. LEAD (MINES): First class Degree in Mining Engineering from a recognized institution with First Class Manager's Competency Certificate (coal). Minimum of 20 years post qualification experience with expertise in Mechanized coal / Lignite Open Cast Mine out of which at least 5 years of experience in a senior position in large capacity fully mechanized mines.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of GIPCL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GIPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for most of the posts, including Diploma Mechanical Engineer, GM Finance, and AGM Finance, is 04 September 2026. For the Lead Mines post, the last date is 06 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by GIPCL?
faq.answer: Gujarat Industries Power Company (GIPCL) has announced a total of 10 vacancies for various posts, including Diploma Mechanical Engineer on Fix Term Contract.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for GIPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for GIPCL Recruitment 2026 is online. Candidates are required to submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for GIPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Diploma Mechanical Engineer post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Diploma Mechanical Engineer post is structured over three years: Rs. 27,000/- in the 1st year, Rs. 28,350/- in the 2nd year, and Rs. 29,760/- in the 3rd year.

faq.question: Q6. What are the minimum qualification requirements for the Finance posts?
faq.answer: For the General Manager (Finance) and Additional General Manager (Finance) posts, candidates must be a Graduate with a professional qualification like Chartered Accountant (CA) or CMA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for GIPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for GIPCL Recruitment 2026 involves an initial application screening followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official GIPCL Recruitment 2026 notification?
faq.answer: The official GIPCL Recruitment 2026 notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum percentage required for Diploma Mechanical Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Diploma Mechanical Engineer post must have a minimum of 65% aggregate or equivalent in their Full Time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.

faq.answer: The provided data does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for information regarding age relaxation.
